finalText:
**Redis went down at 02:14. Everything after that was fallout.**

```
02:14:07  redis refused connections at 10.0.0.12:6379
02:14:07  cache off, every read goes to the store
02:14→02:31  173 timeouts, queue climbs 52 → 568
02:29:12  queue passes its own 500 limit
02:31:44  worker-2 runs out of memory
02:31:52  supervisor kills the api, service down
```

All 13 reconnect tries failed the same way. Redis was never coming back on its own. Nothing turned requests away as the queue grew. That is what turned an outage into a crash.
